description: Memorandum of Understanding on the Partnership Program Established for Capacity Building between the Ministry of Science and Technology of Sri Lanka and the Asian Institute of Technology of the Kingdom of Thailand
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Thailand, is an international institution dedicated to higher education, research and capacity building in the fields of engineering, science, technology and management and it is proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Science and Technology and the said Institution with the aim of strengthening educational and research cooperation. The said MoU will facilitate the academics, research officers and scientists working in the field of science and technology in the country to obtain scholarships for Master of Philosophy (M.Phil) and Doctoral (Ph.D) degree courses under the academic programmes specified in the MoU implemented by the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT). Under the provisions of the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, priority will be given to qualified officers from August 2026 to August 2031 for systematic and international level higher education opportunities and research activities in the key areas such as agriculture, sustainable energy, climate change and environmental sustainability. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to enter into the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.
